e: I don't put sugar in my tea.
I don't like scary films.
I don't remember where I put my keys.

q: أَنَا لَا ___ إِلَى الْعَمَلِ يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ.
e: I don't go to work on Sundays.
I don't use my phone at the table.
I am not afraid of big dogs.
I don't drink milk cold.
I don't know how to cook rice.

q: أَنْتَ لَا ___ أُخْتَكَ فِي الْبَيْتِ أَبَدًا.
e: You never help your sister at home.

q: يَا مُرَادُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ هَذَا الْقَمِيصَ؟
e: Murad, why don't you wear this shirt?

q: أَنْتَ لَا ___ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ فِي الْبَرْدِ.
e: You don't go out of the house in the cold.

q: يَا جَمَالُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ عَلَى الْهَاتِفِ؟
e: Jamal, why don't you answer the phone?
You don't wash your face in the morning!

q: يَا عَادِلُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ سَيَّارَتَكَ بِنَفْسِكَ؟
e: Adel, why don't you fix your car yourself?
You don't know how much I love you.

q: يَا هَانِي، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ؟
e: Hani, why don't you walk to school?
Nadia, why aren't you eating anything?
You don't watch the news on TV.

q: يَا أُخْتِي، أَنْتِ لَا ___ مَعَ أَحَدٍ فِي الْحَفَلَاتِ.
e: Sister, you don't talk to anyone at parties.

q: أَنْتِ لَا ___ إِلَى أَحَدٍ عِنْدَمَا تَغْضَبِينَ.
e: You don't listen to anyone when you get angry.
Suha, why don't you open the door?

q: أَنْتِ لَا ___ فِي الْمَطْبَخِ كَثِيرًا، صَحِيحٌ؟
e: You don't cook in the kitchen much, right?

q: يَا مَيْسَاءُ، أَنْتِ لَا ___ دَوَاءَكِ فِي الْوَقْتِ.
e: Maysa, you don't take your medicine on time.
Salma, you don't look after yourself.

q: يَا لِينَا، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ بِأُمِّكِ؟ هِيَ قَلِقَةٌ.
e: Lina, why don't you call your mother? She is worried.

q: أَنْتِ لَا ___ الْمَدِينَةَ جَيِّدًا، أَنْتِ جَدِيدَةٌ هُنَا.
e: You don't know the city well, you are new here.
My grandfather doesn't wear glasses.
He doesn't open the door to strangers.

q: أَخِي الصَّغِيرُ لَا ___ وَحْدَهُ فِي غُرْفَتِهِ.
e: My little brother doesn't sleep alone in his room.

q: الْمُدِيرُ لَا ___ عَلَى الْهَاتِفِ بَعْدَ السَّادِسَةِ.
e: The manager doesn't answer the phone after six.
This restaurant doesn't sell fish.
My father doesn't take the bus, he goes in his car.
He doesn't think Arabic is hard.

q: الْوَلَدُ لَا ___ فِي الصَّفِّ، هُوَ خَجُولٌ.
e: The boy doesn't speak in class, he is shy.

q: عَمِّي لَا ___ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ، بَيْتُهُ فِي قَرْيَةٍ.
e: My uncle doesn't live in the city, his house is in a village.

q: أُمِّي لَا ___ الْخُبْزَ مِنَ السُّوقِ، تَصْنَعُهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ.
e: My mother doesn't buy bread at the market, she makes it at home.
My friend doesn't eat meat or fish.
The teacher doesn't allow phones in class.
My sister doesn't play any sport.
My grandmother doesn't see well without her glasses.

q: الْبِنْتُ لَا ___ فِي الْبَحْرِ، الْمَاءُ بَارِدٌ.
e: The girl isn't swimming in the sea, the water is cold.

q: هِيَ لَا ___ بِشَيْءٍ إِلَّا إِذَا كَانَتْ مُتَأَكِّدَةً.
e: She doesn't promise anything unless she is sure.
My mother doesn't go to restaurants much.
The cat doesn't like water.
We don't watch TV while we eat.

q: نَحْنُ لَا ___ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، هُوَ يَوْمُ عُطْلَةٍ.
e: We don't work on Friday, it is a day off.
We don't understand this man's dialect.
We don't close the windows in summer.

q: نَحْنُ لَا ___ أَيْنَ سَنَسْكُنُ بَعْدَ الزَّوَاجِ.
e: We don't know where we will live after the wedding.
My sister and I don't wear the same clothes.
We don't travel much, trips are expensive.

q: نَحْنُ لَا ___ لِلْأَطْفَالِ بِاللَّعِبِ فِي الشَّارِعِ.
e: We don't let the children play in the street.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ مَعَ جَدِّكُمْ؟
e: Children, why don't you sit with your grandfather?
You never arrive on time.

q: يَا شَبَابُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ الْخُبْزَ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَخْبَزِ؟
e: Guys, why don't you buy bread from this bakery?

q: يَا أَصْدِقَائِي، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ إِلَى الْحَفْلَةِ؟
e: My friends, why aren't you coming to the party?

q: أَنْتُمْ لَا ___ جَيِّدًا مِنَ الْخَلْفِ، صَحِيحٌ؟
e: You don't hear well from the back, right?

q: يَا طُلَّابُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ أَسْئِلَةً فِي الدَّرْسِ؟
e: Students, why don't you ask questions in the lesson?
You don't cook your meals yourselves.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ أَلْعَابَكُمْ بَعْدَ اللَّعِبِ؟
e: Children, why don't you pick up your toys after playing?

q: أَنْتُمْ لَا ___ الدَّرَّاجَاتِ فِي الشَّارِعِ، صَحِيحٌ؟
e: You don't ride bikes in the street, right?

q: يَا جَمَاعَةُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ شَيْئًا؟ الطَّعَامُ جَاهِزٌ.
e: Everyone, why aren't you eating anything? The food is ready.

q: الْأَوْلَادُ لَا ___ فِي الشَّارِعِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ.
e: The boys don't play in the street after sunset.
They don't drink water from the tap.
Our neighbours don't talk to anyone.
The students don't like morning lessons.

q: هُمْ لَا ___ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ فِي الْحَرِّ.
e: They don't go out of the house in the heat.
The employees don't work on the day of Eid.
The children don't go to bed early in the holidays.

q: الْعُمَّالُ لَا ___ عَنِ الْعَمَلِ حَتَّى الْمَسَاءِ.
e: The workers don't stop working until the evening.
People here don't understand English.
Tourists don't visit the museums on Friday.

q: يَا بَنَاتُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ مَعَ الْأَوْلَادِ؟
e: Girls, why don't you play with the boys?
You don't wear the headscarf at home.

q: يَا صَدِيقَاتِي، أَنْتُنَّ لَا ___ إِلَيَّ أَبَدًا.
e: My friends, you never listen to me.

q: يَا طَالِبَاتُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ عَنِ السُّؤَالِ؟
e: Students, why don't you answer the question?
The girls don't like going out at night.
They don't go to school by bus.
The nurses don't sleep at night.
My sisters don't drink coffee.
